How to read this radar

Trending ranks example narratives by independent source breadth, source-category diversity, and new-account velocity. Likes do not determine the order. Multiple posts from one account count as one source; independence is an illustrative fixture label, not verified bot detection.

Top Coins ranks example coins by 24h unique buyers. Social filters select related narratives; they do not change the 24h market snapshot. Narratives without tokens remain in Top Trending. A shared phrase or ticker alone would not establish a real token match.

These fictional examples demonstrate the page. Live collection, semantic clustering, verified contracts, holder analysis, and server-side ranking history require a connected data service. Your source watchlist and last-visit example snapshot are saved only in this browser.
